description: Execution-verified eval checks (pass@1 by running). LOCAL, DETERMINISTIC, OPT-IN: nothing runs these automatically; a harness must call RunExecCheck explicitly with a seeded temp workspace.

commands: a fixture-local relative .exe path (no absolute path, no .., no shell metacharacters)
policy.timeout: timeout_ms defaults to 30000 and is capped at 120000
policy.not_a_sandbox: No OS isolation, network block or user switch. Treat exec-enabled fixtures as trusted code, like the Go tests a repo already runs.

cases.name: a tiny seeded Go module passes go test ./... with exit 0

workspace_files.sum.go:
package execfixture

func Sum(a, b int) int { return a + b }

cases.name: a deliberately failing test exits non-zero and matches want_exit_code

expect.note: a non-zero exit passes when it is the expected exit code

cases.name: a 1ms deadline kills the command and grades as a failure

expect.note: the killed process reports exit -1; TimedOut is always a failed grade

cases.name: curl is not allowlisted and Validate rejects the fixture

expect.note: RunExecCheck refuses to start the command at all
